description: This Java source file defines a class 'FileBasedCredentialsService' which implements credential management, including loading/saving credentials from/to a file, handling credential retrieval and modification, and resource versioning for a device registry service in the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: FileBasedCredentialsService
classes.description: A credentials service that manages credentials backed by a file, supporting load/save operations, credential retrieval, modification, and resource versioning.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the service, possibly loading credentials from a file, and sets up periodic persistence.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service, saving credentials to a file if configured.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials based on tenant, authId, and type, with support for client context and tracing.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores or updates credentials for a device, supporting resource versioning and credential validation.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes all credentials associated with a specified device.
